# Mobile UI Guide

Mobile UI prioritizes one task, one pane, and recoverable gestures.

## Structure

Single Pane works with BottomSheet, ActionSheet, and dedicated routes. Safe areas and the soft keyboard never cover the current action.

## Gestures

Long press, swipe reply, and conversation swipe have visible alternatives and conflict handling; destructive actions require confirmation.

## Large text

Labels wrap, metadata reflows, and targets do not shrink. Android, iOS, and Flutter Mobile keep native back and scroll behavior.
